sol_preparation.purpose: versioned PRE-02 aggregate and current readiness pointer
sol_preparation.currentPolicy: current_marker is 1 only on the current row and NULL on history rows; MySQL unique key permits multiple historical NULL rows
sol_preparation.crossContextReference: project_id has no database foreign key to PROJ

sol_preparation_item.purpose: one frozen survey item definition and current result per preparation business version
sol_preparation_item.evidencePolicy: JSON array of exact artifactId,versionNo,referenceKey,fileFactVersion,scopeVersion facts; never URL, body or infra location
sol_preparation_item.immutability: items of a submitted preparation business version have no generic update or delete entry

sol_dynamic_form_instance.purpose: PRE-02 V1 fixed form values; not a general schema designer
sol_dynamic_form_instance.immutability: value and schema have no update entry after frozen_at is set

sol_preparation_source_reference.purpose: stable OA or other authoritative source reference and normalized current fact
sol_preparation_source_reference.failurePolicy: SYNCED requires current result/factVersion/watermark and refreshes last-success; ERROR or UNKNOWN clears current authoritative fields, preserves nullable last-success for display, and always blocks readiness
sol_preparation_source_reference.commitPolicy: explicit refresh catches provider failure, commits ERROR/UNKNOWN plus rejected audit, then returns a stable failure; readonly inspect/revalidate never writes this row
sol_preparation_source_reference.normalizedResultPolicy: closed values are supplied by each approved provider contract; UNKNOWN always blocks
sol_preparation_source_reference.crossContextReference: source object has no database foreign key and raw OA document is never copied

sol_preparation_item_waiver.purpose: append-only item waiver approval and effective window
sol_preparation_item_waiver.effectivePolicy: APPROVED and current time within valid_from/valid_until; expiry is derived and triggers readiness reevaluation

sol_preparation_readiness_snapshot.purpose: append-only PRE-02 readiness evaluation with complete frozen inputs and blockers
sol_preparation_readiness_snapshot.immutability: insert and stable query only; no update or delete interface

stateAxes.forbidden: one overloaded state axis or deriving current readiness solely from an old snapshot

preparationItemStateMachine.submit: DRAFT preparation freezes all form/item inputs and becomes PENDING_CONFIRMATION; applicable and not-applicable-pending items remain confirmation PENDING
preparationItemStateMachine.confirmItem: PENDING item becomes CONFIRMED; not-applicable confirmation also sets applicability NOT_APPLICABLE_CONFIRMED; the last unresolved item atomically makes preparation CONFIRMED
preparationItemStateMachine.returnItem: from PENDING_CONFIRMATION or CONFIRMED, mark the selected old item RETURNED and old preparation RETURNED, clear old current_marker, then create businessVersion+1 current DRAFT in the same transaction
preparationItemStateMachine.copyConfirmedItem: unchanged confirmed item copies values, exact evidence, source references, confirmation metadata and source_item_id and remains CONFIRMED
preparationItemStateMachine.resetReturnedItem: copy editable form values, assignment, outsourcing and evidence as a baseline; set item PENDING and form DRAFT; clear confirmation and return metadata
preparationItemStateMachine.copyPendingItem: copy existing editable facts and keep PENDING
preparationItemStateMachine.sourceCopy: copy stable references and last-success fields but clear current authoritative result/version/watermark and set UNKNOWN
preparationItemStateMachine.waiverCopy: do not copy; approved waiver history is selected by tenantId+projectId+itemCode and remains subject to effective window
preparationItemStateMachine.currentInvariant: old current_marker is cleared before the next DRAFT receives marker 1; the unique key allows one current preparation only

transactions.itemConfirm: LOCK_PROJECT_SCOPE; LOCK_CURRENT_PREPARATION_AND_ALL_ITEMS; REVALIDATE_SELECTED_ITEM_FILE_AND_SOURCE_FACTS; CONFIRM_ITEM; IF_ALL_RESOLVED_SET_PREPARATION_CONFIRMED; INVALIDATE_READINESS_INPUT_VERSION; IDEMPOTENCY_SUCCESS; AUDIT
transactions.waiverDecision: LOCK_PROJECT_SCOPE_AND_CURRENT_ROLE; LOCK_ITEM_AND_WAIVER; VALIDATE_FROZEN_APPROVAL_ROLE_AND_STATE; CAS_TERMINAL_RESULT; REEVALUATE_READINESS; AUDIT
transactions.inputMutation: every successful readiness-input mutation increments input_version, sets NOT_READY and snapshot_current=false without appending a snapshot

publicReadinessApi.readOnlyPolicy: inspect and lockAndRevalidate compute and compare facts without writing source, snapshot, pointer or version
publicReadinessApi.readyPolicy: only a snapshotCurrent READY fact whose structured fact vector passes synchronous lock-and-revalidate may be consumed by a later S4 command
publicReadinessApi.unknownPolicy: missing, cross-tenant, non-current, unavailable provider, unknown source, invalid file or any expected-version change fails closed

projectWorkBinding.lockPolicy: join by trusted project and exact target tuple; require exactly one current row; lock Project, ProjectTask and the existing current ExecutionContract by tenantId+projectTaskId+currentMarker, then verify executionContractId, ownership, target tuple, versions and frozen JSON in the caller transaction

dependencies.fileArtifact: consume F-PLT-001 exact reference inspect/lockAndRevalidate; SOL stores no body, URL or infra fact
dependencies.oaSource: consume INT-05 public source provider when available; until then OA-required items are blocked and no-OA items or valid-waiver paths continue
dependencies.impS4: future IMP consumer uses publicReadinessApi; SOL never writes IMP snapshot or stage
dependencies.events: none; approved SDS boundary is synchronous command or query

permissions.frontendBackendTruth: same permission codes; server revalidates trusted tenant, function, ProjectStageScope, current subject, state and version

platformFacts.fileFacts: exact FileArtifact version and reference only
platformFacts.reason: locked SDS defines synchronous command or query and no cross-context event

legacy.policy: V1.7 gap and migration-source evidence only; no current truth, no dual write, no completion inference
reusableSlices: Yudao and Element Plus page patterns

seedRequirements: six approved PRE-02 item dictionary codes
representative template combinations with required/no-source/waiver/disabled cases
